_about.source: Star Wars RPG (FFG) Wiki (star-wars-rpg-ffg.fandom.com), Category:Species and Category:Specialization, read 20 Oct 2026. Homebrew pages (reSpecialized and community species) are left out.
notes: Stats, starting ranks and skill lists only. Species special abilities are linked (wiki), not copied.

careers[].freeRanks: free career-skill ranks at creation (4 for eight-skill careers, 3 for the six-skill Force and Destiny / Jedi careers). Specialisations give 2 (Droids: 2 more career and 1 more specialisation rank).
A specialisation with no careers listed is universal: it can be taken with any career.

freeSkillChoice.note: One rank in any one skill.
One rank each in two different non-career skills.
Either one rank in one combat skill, or one rank each in two Knowledge skills. The GM checks this when approving.
